summary: Template loader cache invalidation after source file changes

message.content:
Fix this bug to solve the issue based on manual.yaml:
  instance_id: acme__web-100
  repo: acme/web
  base_commit: abc123
  problem_statement: Template renderer returns stale content after the source file changes. The template loader cache is not invalidated.

content.text: Implemented timestamp-aware cache invalidation in the template loader so edited templates are reloaded instead of serving stale content.
